SetRandomSeed.scope: U32 seed initializes an owned stream using pinned rprand SplitMix64 extraction and Xoshiro128** state, without implicit global mutation.

GetRandomValue.scope: Owned state plus integral F32 result for bounds -32767..32767; inclusive/swapped bounds and exactly one draw for equal bounds match native rprand.
gaps: Wider integer domains, implicit globals and libc fallback

LoadRandomSequence.scope: Owned rprand duplicate-rejection sequence with exact acceptance order and following-stream position. Integral F32 bounds -32767..32767; reversed bounds preserve the reference's unswapped minimum offset. Explicit Nat draw budget returns partial values and advanced state on exhaustion; invalid requests preserve the original stream.
gaps: Full integer domains and target/resource/performance coverage

UnloadRandomSequence.scope: Consumes the owned sequence and returns Unit; Bend ownership adapts the explicit C allocation/free lifecycle.

DecompressData.scope: Bounded raw DEFLATE with stored/fixed/dynamic blocks, code-length repeats and overlapping copies. Input at most 1 MiB, caller output capacity 0..64 MiB; returns Maybe of owned bytes. Preserves native early completion on empty stored blocks.
gaps: Larger compressed inputs and native pointer/allocation ABI
